name: Stand-Up India Scheme
eligibility: SC/ST or women entrepreneurs above 18, greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services or trading
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. Collateral covered under CGTMSE.

name: PM Mudra Yojana - Tarun
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, or services
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakhs for small business expansion under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana Tarun category. Suitable for working capital or capital expenditure.

name: Mahila Udyam Nidhi Scheme
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs for establishing or expanding small-scale industries
description: Soft loans provided by SIDBI and Punjab National Bank for women-led SSI units. Covers up to 25% of project cost with a repayment period of up to 10 years.

name: WEP Accelerator Program - Cohort 8
eligibility: Women-led startups across all sectors with a minimum viable product and revenue potential
description: Women Entrepreneurship Platform accelerator by NITI Aayog offering grant funding, mentorship, market access, legal support, and investor readiness training over 6 months.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startups less than 2 years old with proof-of-concept stage
description: Seed funding for early-stage DPIIT-recognised startups to validate proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry via selected incubators.

name: FICCI FLO Women Startup Grant
eligibility: Women-led startups demonstrating social and economic impact with at least 6 months of operations
description: Annual grant by FICCI Ladies Organisation recognising women-led startups with demonstrable business traction, social impact, and innovation across any sector.

name: MSME Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme
eligibility: MSME units registered under Udyam with existing manufacturing operations
description: Capital subsidy for technology modernization in MSME manufacturing units. Covers machinery upgrades, process improvements, energy efficiency, and digital integration.

name: NABARD Women Farmer Development Program
eligibility: Women farmers, rural women self-help groups (SHGs), and agri-entrepreneurs
description: NABARD program supporting women in agriculture through grants, training and capacity building for allied activities including food processing, dairy, horticulture, and fisheries.

name: DPIIT Startup India Recognition + Benefits
eligibility: Private limited companies or LLPs less than 10 years old with annual turnover under ₹100 crore
description: DPIIT recognition grants startups 3-year income tax exemption, self-certification under 9 labour and environment laws, IPR fast-track, and access to Fund of Funds (₹10,000 crore corpus).

name: CGTMSE Credit Guarantee Scheme
eligibility: New and existing MSMEs including manufacturing and service enterprises
description: Credit guarantee cover for collateral-free loans to MSMEs. Member lending institutions can extend working capital and term loans up to ₹5 Crore with CGTMSE guarantee.

name: SIDBI ASPIRE — Promoting Innovations in Rural Industry
eligibility: Rural startups and enterprises in agro-based, food processing, and rural services
description: SIDBI scheme promoting innovation and agro-industry entrepreneurship in rural areas through technology development funds and incubation support, focusing on employment generation.

name: Trade Related Entrepreneurship Assistance (TREAD)
eligibility: Women below poverty line groups in non-farm activities via NGOs
amount: Up to ₹30 Lakhs (30% of project cost as grant)
description: Government grant of up to 30% of project cost for rural women groups for trade-related activities including handicrafts, handlooms, food processing, and service enterprises via NGO partners.

name: Annapurna Scheme (SBI / Bank of Baroda)
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in food catering, tiffin, packaged food, or food processing businesses
description: Loans for women in catering and food businesses to buy kitchen equipment, utensils, and working capital. Collateral-free with repayment spread over 36 months.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
eligibility: Women farmers and women in agriculture-allied livelihoods in rural areas
description: Ministry of Rural Development program to improve agricultural and allied livelihood opportunities for women through capacity building, input support and technology access.
checklist: Agricultural land proof or SHG membership

name: DAY-NRLM National Rural Livelihoods Mission
eligibility: Rural women and women SHGs in rural India (below poverty line)
amount: ₹15,000 revolving fund + credit linkage up to ₹6 Lakhs
description: Government flagship poverty reduction mission that creates strong institutions of rural poor women, mobilises SHGs, provides revolving fund, and links them to bank credit.

name: Stree Shakti Package (SBI)
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs with majority stake (>50%) in business and enrolled in state EDP
amount: Up to ₹5 Lakhs (0.5% concession on interest)
description: SBI concessional loan package for women with majority ownership, offering interest rate concession and simplified processing with state government EDP certification.

name: Udyogini Scheme (PWDS / State Finance Corporations)
eligibility: Women below 45 years with annual family income under ₹1.5 Lakhs for general category
amount: Up to ₹3 Lakhs (subsidised interest for SC/ST/widows/disabled)
description: Scheme by Women Development Corporations for underprivileged women entrepreneurs covering 88 business activities with subsidised loans and free for widows/disabled/SC/ST women.

name: PMEGP — PM Employment Generation Programme
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years; for projects above ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing / ₹5 Lakhs in services — 8th pass minimum
description: KVIC administered employment-linked subsidy program for new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector. Women get higher subsidy rate (25% urban, 35% rural) on bank-financed projects.

name: Scheme for Integrated Textile Parks (SITP)
eligibility: Textile and garment manufacturers with minimum 30 units forming a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)
amount: Up to ₹40 Crore per park (infrastructure subsidy)
description: Ministry of Textiles scheme for creating state-of-the-art infrastructure through integrated textile parks. Individual MSME textile units can join through SPVs to access subsidised world-class production facilities.

name: Mission Shakti — Samarthya Component
eligibility: Women SHGs, women-led cooperatives, community-based organisations
description: Ministry of Women and Child Development umbrella scheme that merges One Stop Centres, Mahila Police Volunteers, and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao with economic empowerment grants for women SHGs.
